maya: Quick check on the Alerting > Threshold row + simulated notification modal. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/alerts (frame: simulate-inline). Looking for copy clarity, keyboard order, and how we show per-channel failure states. oliver: Nice compact modal. Two things: 1) CTA should read 'Simulate notification' (explicit), 2) include a collapsed payload preview (first 160 chars) so infra can validate without opening docs. kevin: Accessibility/color nits: helper text contrast under the threshold is ~3.4:1. Bump to 4.5:1. Focus ring should be 3px and use the accent color for visibility. a11y-bot: Live region guidance: use aria-live="polite" and a localized template: "Simulation complete: {successCount} channels, {failCount} failed (simulated)". Ensure aria-atomic="true". Avoid parentheses in the spoken string when possible. oliver: UX behavior: when a channel returns an error (e.g. webhook 500 or 429), show an inline chip state next to that channel pill (yellow for partial/429 with tooltip, red for hard fail) and a tiny 'retry' link. Do not use a global banner. design-bot: Focus flow suggestion: modal open -> focus primary CTA -> payload summary -> channel pill list -> close. Esc restores focus to threshold toggle in the page. maya: Copy tweaks: threshold line should read 'Trigger when request error rate > 5% over a 5-minute rolling window' (explicit window). Preview header: 'Preview (simulated 1 will not change routing)'. CTA: 'Simulate notification'. Helper: 'Last simulated: 2026-03-22 15:00 UTC'. oliver: Small code hint for engineers for the live region: ```
Simulation complete: 2 channels, 1 failed (simulated)
``` Make sure to use localization placeholders in real code. kevin: Mobile behavior: prefer a bottom sheet that leaves a thin threshold header visible so users keep context of which threshold they're simulating. a11y-bot: After dev PR, I'll run quick VoiceOver and NVDA smoke tests for focus & announce behavior. Post results here. maya: Thanks all. I'll update the fig and open a small PR to adjust aria-live string, tab order, payload preview, and inline channel states. Ping me if you want to pair on implementation.
